prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Image 1 is the COMPLETE CARD to edit. Image 2 is a tiny detail identifying the defect to remove, NOT a separate design reference. Output one complete portrait Kalistar Momo card, the SAME aspect ratio and composition as image 1, all edges visible, no mockup or new background.

This is a very restrained final art-direction pass, NOT a redesign. ONLY TWO changes are allowed:
1) Harmonize the LOWER FRAME with the existing UPPER FRAME. Retain exactly the lower panel's existing topology, proportions, blue leather title strip, rose-copper layered mouldings, round side medallions, central electrical hexagon and narrative panel. Make its metal finish, subtle patina, restrained rose-copper colour and soft bevel highlights feel made of the SAME material as the upper name border and the long side rails. The current lower copper is a little brighter/oranger and more sharply outlined than the upper rails: harmonize it subtly, retain tactile painterly relief, avoid flat vector-like outlines. Neatly connect the left and right vertical frame fillets through the transition above the L'ARTISTE MAGIQUE strip, so upper and lower sections look like one continuous crafted frame instead of pasted pieces. No additional ornament and no layout changes.
2) Remove the small stray detached copper line just OUTSIDE the upper-left perimeter of the LEFT weapon medallion, around ten o'clock, shown in detail image 2. The LEFT and RIGHT circular metal bezels must be exact mirror counterparts in construction: identical uninterrupted circular rims, thickness, concentric rings and finish, no left-only extra spur or trailing stroke. Mirror ONLY bezel geometry, NOT the two different icons. Keep the white guitar unchanged and the robot emblem unchanged.

STRICT INVARIANTS: Keep the character illustration EXACTLY as supplied: same Momo robot, hat, face, flute, hands, pose, boots, scrap rocks, starry blue background, lighting, colour and crop. Do not reinterpret or repaint that illustration. Keep every statistic, icon, electrical aura, blue defense barrier, existing coloured barcode, yellow Chroma banner and all text exactly where and as they are. Do not adjust their size, visibility or position. Keep horizontal position badges 3 then 4 near the barcode. The flag must stay entirely within its current boundaries and NOT overlap the right metal rail. Keep all typography and wording, no spelling changes. Name MOMO. Version L'ARTISTE MAGIQUE. Profession NETTOYEUR. Race ROBOT. ATK column from top to bottom: 202, 167, green clover, 84, blue potion, 29. DEF column from top to bottom: 200, 167, green clover, 100, 59, 11. Preserve the lively yellow electricity and its dark textured filling. Narrative EXACTLY: "Au milieu des rebuts de Chroma, Momo joue pour ceux que l'on a oubliés. Sa flûte éveille une lumière dans la ferraille. Il ne sait pas encore si quelqu'un l'écoute. Alors il continue." Preserve the paragraph's placement and line spacing. No new text, symbols, stats, art, symbols on the frame or watermarks. This must read as the same card with a more cohesive frame and the one left ring defect repaired.
note: Full-card generation interpreted the character despite the preservation instruction. The final visual proposal restores the original upper 1018 rows, including illustration, numerical values, symbols, barcode and faction flag. Only the generated lower region is retained. The current layered V4 master and V3 site/data are untouched.
